exceptions.reason: The window is transparent so the rounded .shell gives it its shape; .shell paints the theme background.
Segmented control: the options share one track and read as a single control.
List rows: full-width rows that highlight on hover, stacked like menu items.
Options show their title as text; a row half scrolled out of its list reads as unlabeled to the check.
Segmented options show their label as text; an option half scrolled out of a tools list reads as unlabeled to the check.
Catalogue cards show their name and summary as text; a card half scrolled out of the grid reads as unlabeled to the check.
Tabs share the strip at equal widths; a long title ends in an ellipsis and shows in full on hover.
A session card's title is its visible label; the check misreads it when the column's scroll cuts the card at the window's bottom edge.
A question's option shows its label as text; the check misreads it where the docked composer covers the end of the thread.

A long document folds behind Show all on purpose; the fade shows there is more. Its text is the thread's (--text on --panel, as in replies); the check cannot read the background through the fade's pseudo element.
A code artifact scrolled half under the window header (960x640) has no single background to measure; where it shows, it is the code block's own text on its own background, as in replies.
Show all is --muted on the card's --panel (5.9:1 in the default theme); the check cannot measure it where the docked composer overlaps the end of the thread.
The step summary is its visible label; the check misreads it when the thread's scroll cuts it at the top edge.
Window caption buttons sit edge to edge, as in the OS title bar.
Reviewed: chart labels are --text or --muted SVG text on the chart's own --panel card (at least 4.5:1 in every built-in theme). axe can't sample the background behind SVG text.
Visually hidden on purpose: a chart's values as a table for screen readers; the chart shows the same values to the eye.
Math follows TeX metrics and fonts.

Reviewed: the setup wizard's counts are --muted on its opaque --panel card (6.7:1 in the default theme). axe can't read the card's color(srgb) background and samples the page behind the modal, where the session column starts under them.
Reviewed: placeholder is --muted on an opaque --bg (at least 5.6:1 in every built-in theme). axe can't sample the background of fields below the fold.
Reviewed: on home the placeholder sits over the backdrop picture under a fixed veil, which axe can't measure. It is --muted, at least 4.7:1 there in every built-in theme.

Reviewed: connector descriptions are --muted on the add dialog's opaque --panel (about 6.7:1 in the default theme); axe reports them as overlapping in the dialog's scrolling grid and can't measure them.
Reviewed: the session column is --text and --muted on the session's opaque panel. The session actions menu drops over them, and axe can't sample text under the menu.

Reviewed: the onboarding dialog's copy is --text and --muted on the dialog's opaque --panel (at least 4.5:1 in every built-in theme). Axe flags it where the dialog's scroll region or transition overlaps it and no single background is measurable.

Reviewed: artifact titles are --text on the card's opaque --panel, the same pairing as thread body text. The setup view keeps the onboarding dialog open over the session, and axe cannot sample anything rendered under the dialog.

Reviewed: field placeholders are --muted on the field's opaque --bg (at least 4.5:1 in every built-in theme); axe cannot measure a placeholder background. Typed text is --text on the same surface and passes wherever sampled.
Reviewed: turned-off cards dim their rows on purpose; the same text passes at full opacity when the provider or connector is on.
Reviewed: catalogue grid cards truncate long names and descriptions with an ellipsis on purpose; the full text shows in the card's title tooltip on hover, like tab titles.

Reviewed: queued message text is --text and --muted over the composer's translucent surface above the thread fade; axe samples the gradient through the layers. The composer textarea carries the same construction and the same exception.

Reviewed: model names are --text on the picker's opaque --panel and pass wherever fully visible; axe flags the row where the picker's scroll region cuts it mid-list and no single background is measurable.
